## Change

Explain the problem and resulting behavior. Link specifications and requirement IDs
when applicable.

## Review focus

Ownership/API, schema/persisted meaning, dependency/license and permission changes.
Include only applicable concerns. Explain changes to accepted requirements or design.

## Evidence

Commands actually run and outcomes; relevant failure/cancellation cases.
Mark host/provider tests unverified when unavailable. Include UI screenshots for
visual changes using synthetic content only.

## Limits

Remaining gaps or follow-ups. Do not claim completion from compilation alone.
